title: Podcast Loudness Normalizer input
description: Normalize the loudness of one or more public audio/video URLs with two-pass FFmpeg loudnorm (EBU R128 measurement). Pass `url` for one file or `files` for a batch. Each result row has a download URL and before/after integrated loudness (LUFS), loudness range (LU) and true peak (dBTP).

url.title: Audio or video URL
url.description: Direct, publicly downloadable URL of ONE audio or video file (http/https; redirects followed). Any FFmpeg-readable format: mp3, wav, m4a, aac, flac, ogg, opus, mp4, mov, mkv, webm... Max 2 GB. Must be the media file itself, not a YouTube/Spotify/web page. The first audio stream is normalized. Example: https://download.samplelib.com/mp3/sample-15s.mp3

files.title: Batch of files
files.description: Optional batch, processed sequentially. Array of objects {"url": string (required), plus any of preset, targetLufs, truePeakDbtp, loudnessRange, outputFormat, sampleRate, channels to override the top-level values for that file}. Plain URL strings are also accepted. Example: [{"url":"https://example.com/ep1.wav"},{"url":"https://example.com/ep1-clip.mp4","preset":"youtube","outputFormat":"mp4"}]. Failed items return status=error and are not charged.

preset.title: Loudness target preset
preset.description: Integrated loudness target. podcast/apple = -16 LUFS (Apple Podcasts and most podcast hosts recommend -16 stereo); spotify/youtube = -14 LUFS (streaming platforms); ebu-r128 = -23 LUFS (European broadcast); atsc-a85 = -24 LUFS (US TV); custom = the value in targetLufs. Default: podcast. If the true-peak ceiling cannot be honoured at the target (very peaky audio), the ceiling wins and the result may land slightly below target (see normalizationType=dynamic in the output).

targetLufs.title: Custom target (LUFS)
targetLufs.description: Integrated loudness target in LUFS, used only when preset=custom (e.g. -18 for audiobooks/ACX-style voice, -19 for mono podcasts). Range -70 to -5. Ignored for other presets.

truePeakDbtp.title: True-peak ceiling (dBTP)
truePeakDbtp.description: Maximum true peak in dBTP (inter-sample peaks, measured with 4x oversampling). Default -1 dBTP (Apple/Spotify/YouTube recommendation). Use -2 for content that will be re-encoded at low bitrates, -1.5 for extra safety. The encoded output is re-measured and re-rendered with a tighter ceiling if lossy encoding pushed it over. Range -9 to 0.

loudnessRange.title: Loudness range target (LU)
loudnessRange.description: Target loudness range (LRA) in LU passed to loudnorm. Default 11 (FFmpeg default; leaves natural dynamics). Lower values (e.g. 7) compress dynamics more for noisy listening environments, but only take effect if the input LRA is larger. Range 1-50.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: Output container/codec. mp3 = MP3 CBR 192 kbps (universal podcast delivery); m4a = AAC 192 kbps; wav = 24-bit PCM (for further editing); flac = lossless; mp4 = keeps the input video stream untouched (no re-encode) and replaces the audio with normalized AAC 192 kbps - requires a video input. Audio formats drop any video. Default: mp3.

sampleRate.title: Output sample rate (Hz)
sampleRate.description: Optional output sample rate in Hz, e.g. 44100 or 48000. Default: same as the input (mp3 is capped at 48000). Leave empty unless your platform requires a specific rate.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Output channel layout. keep = same as input (default); mono = downmix to 1 channel (smaller files for voice-only shows); stereo = 2 channels.

maxDurationSeconds.title: Max input duration (s)
maxDurationSeconds.description: Safety cap in seconds on input duration (default 14400 = 4 hours). Longer inputs are rejected with status=error and are not charged. Billing is per started minute of input audio.
